about: What a capture signal usually means, to tell the agent what to confirm. Background only: never evidence, never cited. Match on process and/or port (service side).

signatures.means: Dell PowerProtect Data Manager (PPDM) agent service, which the PPDM server connects in to for backups
signatures.confirm: which system connects in on TCP 7000, whether it is the backup platform, and which data it copies out

signatures.means: Cisco Secure Workload (Tetration) agent processes, which send flow and process telemetry to the Secure Workload service
signatures.confirm: where the Secure Workload service runs (SaaS or on premises) and what telemetry leaves the host

signatures.means: Splunk universal forwarder sending events to an indexer
signatures.confirm: where the indexer sits and which logs are sent

signatures.means: Microsoft Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) client talking to its management point
signatures.confirm: the management point and what content it delivers

signatures.means: System Center Operations Manager agent reporting to its management server
the RevBroadcast service sending radio data out over HTTPS (Azure Service Bus in the flow map)
signatures.confirm: the destination service and what data each message carries

signatures.means: a Windows SMB client session (file share, cluster witness, backup target or software share)
signatures.confirm: what share is opened on the peer and what data moves
which application or user reads or writes which database

signatures.means: SQL Server availability group endpoint replicating databases between replicas
signatures.confirm: which replicas and whether replication crosses sites or zones
which application uses the database and what it holds

signatures.means: a web application or API served or called over HTTP(S)
signatures.confirm: which application and what data it serves or sends

signatures.means: Windows' own services (update, licensing, SmartScreen, Defender) reaching Microsoft and CDN endpoints
signatures.confirm: that no system data leaves through these connections
